title: How to Replace a Video Character with Codex MCP and Medux
description: This tutorial shows a compact Codex + MCP workflow: upload a source video and a reference character image, call the Medux character replacement tool, wait for the render, and save the finished MP4.
operation: This tutorial shows a compact Codex + MCP workflow: upload a source video and a reference character image, call the Medux character replacement tool, wait for the render, and save the finished MP4.
prompt: project/ ├── character.mp4 # source video with the original person └── character.jpg # reference character image for replacement
